gen-dafont-disorder-gf-blinker: Disorder spreads its raw, widely spaced glyphs across the line with no swelling at the joins, while Blinker keeps its lowercase large and its apertures open. Rough above, tidy below.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic holds a high-set x-height and a generous opening in the c, giving the text a modern, composed look. Carrois Gothic handles quiet reading; Disorder, with zero stroke contrast, handles shouting.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC draws a clear opening at the end of every curve, and its capitals sit nearly level with the lowercase. Expect a smooth, approachable flow under Disorder.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-chivo: Curves that match the stems exactly give Disorder its blunt, scrappy look, and Chivo answers with lowercase packed up toward the caps. Rough energy meets visible daylight in every bowl.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-chocolate-classic: Raw and rattled, Disorder draws a plain, unshaded line that never swells. Chocolate Classical Sans uses a broad-nibbed stroke and a sizable lowercase, so a long page moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-comme: Disorder runs a single stroke width through the whole alphabet, with big lowercase and glyphs kept well apart. Comme takes over with smooth curves that never clog, so text glides along.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte gives each lowercase e a wide-eyed look and a prominent x-height, with n arches as thick as their stems. Disorder supplies the chaos above it.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-duru-sans: Chaos with a tidy partner: Disorder draws even its g in one unchanging line weight. Duru Sans has wide openings on small letters, so shrinking the heading would blur its rawness.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-fresca: Scrappy up top, smooth below. Disorder leaves its curves unswollen and its glyphs apart, while Fresca keeps its counters connected to the outside space, with short ascenders above big bowls.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans leaves tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line, and its e opens like a pried clasp. Under Disorder, text moves along cleanly.
